content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Worcester

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's baseline requirements—typically a secondary degree plus years of professional project experience, or a four-year degree with fewer years required. Gather your credentials and work history before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend sessions from anywhere, on a schedule that fits your job at healthcare, insurance, higher education, or advanced-manufacturing employers across Worcester. Our active certified practitioners deliver real-world examples throughout the curriculum.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your contact hours, submit your formal PMI application with documentation of your education and project experience. Pay the PMI examination fee. PMI will review and approve your application before you schedule your exam appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence. Schedule your exam at a testing center convenient to you. You'll answer questions on project initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closing across all industry contexts.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to PMI's three-year renewal cycle. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) by taking courses, attending conferences, mentoring, or publishing. Renew on schedule to keep your credential active and recognized by employers in your local job market.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
